food: Benchmark: many cafés keep ingredient costs at about 25–35% of sales, and wages at about 25–35%.
margin: Benchmark: independent coffee shops typically keep about 10–20% of sales as profit.
ltv: Benchmark: LTV of at least 3× CAC is a common target; the median company reports about 2×.
churn: Benchmark: small-business software often loses 3–7% of customers a month; enterprise software under 1%.
conv: Benchmark: online stores typically turn about 1.5–3% of visitors into buyers.
roas: Benchmark: online ads typically bring in about 3–4.5× what they cost.
util: Benchmark: service firms averaged about 66% billable time in 2025; 75% is a common target.
loan: Benchmark: small-business bank loans cost roughly 6–11% a year.
fail: Benchmark: about 17–26% of restaurants close in their first year (not the often-quoted 90%).
cafeVal: Benchmark: small cafés typically sell for about 2× a year’s owner earnings.
shopVal: Benchmark: online stores typically sell for about 3.4× a year’s earnings.
agencyVal: Benchmark: small service businesses typically sell for about 2.3–2.5× a year’s earnings.
saasVal: Benchmark: private software companies typically sell for about 3–7× annual recurring revenue.
